body.text: Two silent dead ends got explicit states: the plan finder rendered nothing when recommend() returned null (four answered questions, blank panel) and now names the cause and offers 'change the budget' / 'ask us to size it'; a deck with no annual price left the term-toggle slot empty and now says why. Plus content/pages/domains.md's #domain-search hero CTA pointed at a section with no id — fixed, with tests/anchors.test.ts checking every in-page anchor in every content file
